Naked: Few small scars on arms and legs from training and minor skirmishes
Story: Sigrid grew up on the rugged coasts, learning to wield an axe almost as soon as she could walk. Her family were farmers, but she always felt the call of the sea and battle. At 16, she joined a training group for shieldmaidens, quickly proving her strength and tactical mind. She has participated in several coastal raids and earned a reputation for her cool head in a skirmish.
